question: If a NEW plaque is used to call attention to a new sign, how long should it remain, and may strobe lights be used to enhance sign conspicuity?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The evidence provided does not contain any provision about a NEW plaque or how long it should remain in place, so that part of the question cannot be answered from this evidence. On the second part, the MUTCD flatly prohibits the use of strobe lights to enhance sign conspicuity. Standards (mandatory): - "Strobe lights shall not be used to enhance the conspicuity of highway signs." Citations: - Section 2A.11 Standard §4 (p.49)
gold_answer: The NEW plaque should remain only for a period determined by engineering judgment and no more than 12 months. Strobe lights may not be used to enhance highway-sign conspicuity.
